title: Fussy Eating
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind fussy eating and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply fussy eating in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using fussy eating to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to fussy eating. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
